messages:
maya-ml: Heads-up — since the equinox9b 4-bit qconfig rollout weve seen a reproducible regen/rewind pattern on short prompts (2-4 tokens). Sample: 

maya-ml: input: "Translate: Hello"
maya-ml: fp16 output (ok): "Hola"
maya-ml: q4f16 output (weird): "Hola Hola Hola..." (repeats after token 2)

sam-platform: ack. are you seeing this across batches or single-request traces?

maya-ml: single-request traces. also noticed higher KV cache hit rate in metrics but latency spikes when it starts repeating.

liam-sre: can you paste the small trace? any error logs from runtime?

maya-ml: pasted snippet of runtime debug: 

maya-ml: ```
maya-ml: [2024-11-02T15:02:10Z] request_id=req-9b-112 step=decode token=2 kv_hit=true cache_len=16
maya-ml: [2024-11-02T15:02:10Z] request_id=req-9b-112 attention_mask_mismatch=false
maya-ml: [2024-11-02T15:02:10Z] request_id=req-9b-112 decode_output=\"Hola\"
maya-ml: [2024-11-02T15:02:10Z] request_id=req-9b-112 repeat_detected=true repeat_count=1
maya-ml: ```

ana-ops: @ana-ops FYI can we check if the quant/kernel combo for eqx9b changed kernel ordering? last time ordering divergence caused kv indexing mismatch.

ana-ops: (typo above) meant @zane-research and @ana-ops

zane-research: I ran a diff between fp16 and q4f16 attention key generation. Theres a subtle dtype cast in the fused-attn kernel that reorders the key buffer when seq_len < 8 under continuous batching. That can make kv lookups point to previous positions.

sam-platform: interesting. could explain regen if the model sees stale keys as repeated context. can you repro locally with continuous-batching off?

zane-research: yes — disabling continuous batching removes repeats in my local harness. perf drops but correctness returns.

liam-sre: ops question: which hosts/driver version is the canary on? any difference between host pools?

maya-ml: Canary = gpu-pool-eqx-v3 driver 525.80, runtime 2.9.3, qconfig=q4f16-default-v2. Prod rollout used same but autoscaler mixed ephemeral nodes on p4s.

ana-ops: suggest steps: 1) pause canary rollout 2) pin runtime to 2.9.2 where fusion order matched 3) add perf test to detect kv reordering (short prompts)

sam-platform: created a quick patch to runtime to add an assert that checks kv indices when seq_len < 8. deploy-bot: can you run it on canary pool?

deploy-bot: deploy request received: runtime/2.9.3+kv-assert -> gpu-pool-eqx-v3-canary. ETA ~ 6m. :worker:
